name: Mardi Himal High Camp and viewpoint
why: A ridge trek through moss forest to a grassy crest right under the fishtail of Machhapuchhre, quieter than the sanctuary below.
book: Annapurna Conservation Area permit and TIMS card. Since April 2023 Nepal requires foreign trekkers to hire a licensed guide in its national parks and conservation areas (check the current rule before you go). Taxi from Pokhara to Kande (45 min). Few small lodges at High Camp: book in season.
water: Lodges at Forest Camp, Low Camp and High Camp; nothing above High Camp.
dangers: The ridge above High Camp is exposed to wind and has no shelter.
Snow on the ridge from December to March.
turnaround: From High Camp leave at 05:00 for the viewpoint and be back by 10:00, before the clouds.

points.name: Kande

points.name: Forest Camp
